name: Zenobia Shroff
biography: Zenobia Shroff (born May 27, 1965) is an Indian-American actress appearing in film, theater and television. Shroff is known for her breakthrough role in The Big Sick (2017), and she stars as Muneeba Khan, the title character's mother, in the Disney+ TV series Ms. Marvel (2022).
